name: Oppai Sensou - Kyonyuu VS Hinnyuu -
original_name: おっぱい戦争 -巨乳VS貧乳-
source:
In the 22nd century, the body of women is clearly divided in 2 types. They are really big or really small and there's no in-between.
They try to determine their superiority over another and it divided the world in two...

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE065696.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
22世紀，成年女性的身體明顯分成兩種類型：胸部不是非常豐滿，就是一片平坦，沒有介於兩者之間的人。
雙方試圖證明自己比另一方更優越，整個世界也因此一分為二……

[摘自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE065696.html]DLsite English[/url]]
